description: This file implements the AttendeeRepository class, which provides methods for accessing and updating attendee data in a database using Prisma ORM. It includes functions for finding attendees by various criteria and updating their 'noShow' status.

classes.name: AttendeeRepository
classes.description: Implements attendee data access methods using Prisma ORM, adhering to IAttendeeRepository interface.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an attendee by their unique ID, returning name and email.

methods.name: findByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple attendees by an array of IDs, returning their id, name, and email.

methods.name: findByBookingIdAndSeatReference
methods.description: Finds attendees associated with a specific booking ID and seat reference UID, returning their emails.

methods.name: findByBookingUidAndEmails
methods.description: Finds attendees by booking UID and list of emails, returning id, email, and noShow status.

methods.name: updateNoShow
methods.description: Updates the noShow status for a specific attendee identified by attendeeId.

methods.name: findByBookingId
methods.description: Retrieves all attendees associated with a specific booking ID, returning detailed info.

methods.name: updateManyNoShowByBookingIdAndEmails
methods.description: Updates noShow status for multiple attendees by booking ID and emails.

methods.name: updateManyNoShowByBookingIdExcludingEmails
methods.description: Updates noShow status for attendees with a specific booking ID, excluding certain emails.
